body:
## Story Points: 8 | Priority: P0 | Sprint: 1

## Summary
Secure user registration, JWT login, account locking, and profile management.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Registration enforces password policy (8+ chars, upper, lower, number, special @$!%*?&)
- [ ] Role always CUSTOMER; role field in request body is ignored (no privilege escalation)
- [ ] Passwords stored as BCrypt hash; never returned in any API response
- [ ] Successful login returns JWT; failed attempts tracked per user
- [ ] Account locked after 5 consecutive failures; locked accounts return 403
- [ ] Inactive accounts return 403 on login attempt
- [ ] GET /api/v1/users/me returns profile without passwordHash field
- [ ] PUT /api/v1/users/me allows update of fullName and phone only
- [ ] All error messages are safe (no stack traces, no SQL)

## Tests
AuthServiceTest (9) + AuthControllerTest (7) + UserControllerTest (5) = 21 tests

## Code
AuthController, AuthService, UserController, SecurityConfig, JwtUtil

## Definition of Done
All 21 tests pass; no password hash in any response; account lock enforced after 5 failures.
